apps.name: Brain Test
apps.tagline: Can your Tesla brain? A 20-second test of the car's computer, ranked against other Teslas, phones and PCs.

apps.name: Brick Breaker
apps.tagline: Classic paddle game. Drag to move, tap to launch.

apps.name: Fractal Explorer
apps.tagline: Multi-threaded WebAssembly Mandelbrot. Pinch to zoom.

apps.name: Sleep Sounds
apps.tagline: Rain, ocean, campfire and more for Camp Mode, with a dim clock and sleep timer.

apps.name: Audiobooks
apps.tagline: Thousands of free audiobooks read by volunteers, with resume and a sleep timer. For Camp Mode and long charging stops.

apps.name: Campfire
apps.tagline: A crackling fire with sparks and crickets. Cozy screen for the campsite.

apps.name: Star Map
apps.tagline: What's in the sky tonight: stars, planets and the Moon over your campsite.

apps.name: Weather
apps.tagline: Forecast, sunset, true darkness, Moon and a stargazing rating for tonight.

apps.name: Satellite Tracker
apps.tagline: When to see the ISS, Hubble and new Starlink trains pass over you.

apps.name: Sky Events
apps.tagline: Meteor showers, full moons, eclipses and planets for the year ahead, and what is up tonight.

apps.name: What's Around Me
apps.tagline: History, landmarks and nature near where you are parked, from Wikipedia. Great while charging.

apps.name: What's Under Me
apps.tagline: The rock under your car in plain words: a drill core down through time, how old each layer is and the fossils found nearby.

apps.name: Pit Stop
apps.tagline: Restrooms, coffee, food and shops within walking distance of the charger, with what's open now.

apps.name: Planes Overhead
apps.tagline: A live flight radar. See what's flying over you, where it's headed and where to look for it.

apps.name: Road Trip Postcard
apps.tagline: Turn where you're parked into a vintage postcard, with your town in big map-filled letters, and send it to your phone.

apps.name: Speed Test
apps.tagline: How fast is the car's internet right now? Download, upload and ping, on Wi-Fi or LTE.

apps.name: Car Benchmark
apps.tagline: See what this car's browser can do.

apps.name: Arcade
apps.tagline: Twenty arcade games from 1977 to 1986 on MAME, free from their makers through mamedev.org: Robby Roto, Gridlee, Targ, Super Tank and more, sent from your phone.

apps.name: Tiny Games
apps.tagline: Nine free retro games on the TIC-80 fantasy console, plus any .tic carts you send from your phone. Touch or controller.

apps.name: Retro Console
apps.tagline: Play homebrew games, or NES, Game Boy, GBA, Master System, Game Gear, Atari Lynx, TurboGrafx-16 and Genesis games you own sent from your phone, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: FrunkStore Token
apps.tagline: The community token's live price chart, your wallet's balance, and a way to buy it on your phone.

apps.name: Craft 4K
apps.tagline: Notch's tiny Minecraft4k rebuilt in C++ and ray-marched on the graphics chip: a big block world with sun shadows, day and night, and mirrors to build with.

apps.name: Freedoom
apps.tagline: The classic Doom engine with the free Freedoom games, or Doom games you own sent from your phone, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: Blasphemer
apps.tagline: The Heretic engine with the free dark-fantasy game Blasphemer, or Heretic you own sent from your phone. Spells, relics and flight.

apps.name: LibreQuake
apps.tagline: The classic Quake engine with the free LibreQuake, or Quake you own sent from your phone, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: Duke Nukem 3D
apps.tagline: The 1996 shooter's first episode, free, or the full game you own sent from your phone, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: Command & Conquer
apps.tagline: Command & Conquer and Red Alert, the 1995 and 1996 real-time strategy classics EA made free: both sides' campaigns and skirmish, by touch.

apps.name: The Elder Scrolls
apps.tagline: Arena and Daggerfall, Bethesda's 1994 and 1996 open-world RPGs, free from Bethesda: whole provinces to roam, with a controller or by touch.

apps.name: Death Rally
apps.tagline: Remedy's 1996 top-down death race, the free shareware episode: machine guns, mines and turbo on six tracks, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: Wolfenstein 3D
apps.tagline: id Software's 1992 shooter that started the genre, the free first episode in full: escape Castle Wolfenstein floor by floor, with a controller or on screen.

apps.name: OpenTTD
apps.tagline: Build a transport empire with trains, trucks, ships and planes. The open-source Transport Tycoon, made for touch.

apps.name: fheroes2
apps.tagline: Heroes of Might and Magic II from your own copy, on the open-source fheroes2 engine: towns, heroes and turn-based battles, by touch.

apps.name: Prince of Persia
apps.tagline: The 1989 original on SDLPoP: sixty minutes to escape the dungeons and stop the Vizier. Twelve levels, with a controller or by touch.

apps.name: SuperTux
apps.tagline: Tux's jump-and-run adventure across Icy Island and the Rooted Forest, plus two bonus islands: about a hundred levels. Touch or controller.

apps.name: OpenArena
apps.tagline: Fast arena shooting against bots on the Quake III engine: a free game with ten arenas, on screen or with a controller.

apps.name: Block Builder
apps.tagline: Build anything in a Minecraft Classic-style world of blocks: creative mode, flying, and worlds that save as you play.

apps.name: City Builder
apps.tagline: Found a city and grow it from a village to a megalopolis: zones, roads, power, taxes and disasters, in the classic 1989 city simulation, now open source.

apps.name: Adventure Games
apps.tagline: Classic point-and-click adventures on ScummVM: twelve free games, or ones you own sent from your phone.

apps.name: Text Adventures
apps.tagline: Zork I, II and III, the Infocom classics, now open source, plus two more free adventures. Tap words to build commands, or type.

apps.name: ASCII Quests
apps.tagline: Scott Miller's Kroz games, 1987 to 1990, now open source: seven text-mode quests of gems, whips and creatures. Tap to walk.

apps.name: Logic Puzzles
apps.tagline: Forty classic logic puzzles by Simon Tatham, from Solo (sudoku) to Mines and Net, with endless new boards in every size.

apps.name: Daily Pokémon Guess
apps.tagline: Guess the day's secret Pokémon in eight tries from its generation, types, height and weight. The same one for everyone, plus free play from any generations.

apps.name: Mahjong
apps.tagline: Hong Kong or Taiwan rules against three bots, with every hand scored for you, hints, and a game that carries on where you left off.

apps.name: Chess vs Stockfish
apps.tagline: Full games against Stockfish 19, from a gentle beginner level up to full strength. Take back a move, ask for a hint and pick up where you left off.

apps.name: Chess Puzzle
apps.tagline: Solve the Lichess daily chess puzzle on your screen.

apps.name: Terrarium
apps.tagline: An aquarium that keeps living while you're away. Feed it, watch it evolve. By Jason Goldfeder.
